name: _grid.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  home-mosaic/_grid.scss — the .home-mosaic masonry container: JS-driven
//  height transition and per-breakpoint min-heights. Imported by
//  home-mosaic.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// height is set inline by JS (containerH). Transitioning it makes the about
// section below slide smoothly when a card expands / collapses on hover.
.home-mosaic {
  transition: height 0.42s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  // Mobile: skip height transition — triggers layout recalc each frame
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    transition: none;
  }
  min-height: var(--space-9xl);

  @include layout-540() {
    min-height: var(--space-10xl);
  }
  @include layout-960() {
    min-height: var(--space-9xl);
  }
  @include layout-1440() {
    min-height: calc(var(--space-8xl) + var(--space-5xl));
  }
  @include layout-1920() {
    min-height: var(--space-8xl);
  }
}
